description:
The `make duplicate-check-verbose` report (2026-03-12, post wave-2) shows 344
duplicate groups / 8,051 duplicated lines (threshold 9,476). Wave-3 triage of
the top-30 groups identifies 13 groups that are intentional boilerplate, wave-2
extraction residuals, protocol conformance, TPC spec-mandated query patterns,
or AST structural false positives. These should be suppressed via ignore_rules
to reduce noise and focus the checker on genuine consolidation targets.

Groups to mark as ignored (by current report rank):

G1  (68 lines): generate_company_dimension / generate_customer_dimension /
    generate_security_dimension in tpcdi/generator/sql.py. Wave-2 residual:
    these are thin wrappers calling _build_dimension_sql with domain-specific
    column expressions. The 34-line structural match is the wrapper pattern,
    not duplicated logic.

G2  (55 lines): aggregation_distinct_groupby_expression_impl /
    aggregation_distinct_groupby_pandas_impl /
    aggregation_groupby_large_expression_impl in
    read_primitives/dataframe_queries.py. H2O.db benchmark spec-driven query
    variants. Wave-2 extracted aggregation_groupby_impl for some pandas variants;
    the remaining 6 copies (expression + large) are spec-mandated groupby patterns
    varying only by column names and cardinality.

G3  (55 lines): classify_error / date_add / date_sub across 6 files.
    AST false positive - these are different functions with different return
    types and semantics (error classification vs datetime arithmetic) that
    happen to share the facade/delegation AST shape.

G5  (48 lines): get_operations_by_category / get_queries_by_category across
    5 primitives modules (ai_primitives, metadata_primitives, read_primitives,
    transaction_primitives, write_primitives). Query catalog lookup methods
    with type variance (dict[str, str] vs dict[str, Operation]). The 12-line
    pattern is intentional per-type catalog API. Not worth a shared base class
    for the type generics overhead.

G6  (48 lines): get_all_create_table_sql in amplab, read_primitives, ssb.
    Wave-2 residual: all three now delegate to schema_utils.collect_create_table_sql.
    The structural match is the wrapper (passing table_order + per-table fn).

G7  (48 lines): supports_acl_introspection / supports_column_grants /
    supports_role_hierarchy in metadata_primitives/ddl.py. Intentional
    capability-matrix methods. Each defines a different platform set.
    Consolidating would require a capability-type string parameter that
    obscures the intent.

G8  (48 lines): generate_data / get_all_aliases / get_benchmark_info across
    platform_registry.py, datavault.py, nyctaxi.py, tpch_skew.py, tsbs_devops.py.
    Facade API conformance methods - same pattern as __init__ facades already
    ignored in wave-2.

G9  (48 lines): get_queries_by_category in tpcdi/query_analytics.py,
    tpcdi/query_etl.py, tpcdi/query_validation.py. Same catalog lookup pattern
    as G5. Extend existing wave-2 rule for TPC-DI query modules.

G19 (44 lines): get_dataframe_metadata_manager / get_dataframe_transaction_manager /
    get_dataframe_write_manager across 3 primitives dataframe_operations modules.
    Wave-2 residual: these now delegate to _get_dataframe_manager in
    dataframe_manager_factory.py. Structural match is the wrapper pattern.

G20 (44 lines): validate_customer_tier / validate_gender / validate_trade_type
    in tpcdi/etl/validation.py. Domain-specific validators that intentionally
    follow the same isin(valid_set) pattern with different column names and
    valid value sets.

G21 (44 lines): __init__ across 5 unrelated classes (tpcdi/tools/data_cleaners.py,
    base/data_loading.py x2, unified_frame.py x2). Constructor boilerplate:
    docstring + attribute assignment. Different classes, different attributes.

G22 (44 lines): calculate_official_metrics / execute_operation / get across
    5 files. AST false positive - three different function names with different
    purposes that share the delegation/accessor AST shape.

G27 (43 lines): q26_expression_impl / q7_expression_impl in
    tpcds/dataframe_queries/queries.py. TPC-DS spec pair: Q7 and Q26 both
    compute aggregated metrics from item-joined fact tables with promotional
    filtering. Same structural pattern, different dimension tables and measures.

After adding rules, rebaseline: threshold = ceil(actual * 1.10).

anti_patterns.dont: add overly broad function name ignores
anti_patterns.why: broad ignores mask future real duplicates that should be consolidated, defeating the purpose of the checker

anti_patterns.instead: extend existing rules by adding function names or paths
anti_patterns.why: multiple rules matching the same function create maintenance burden when paths change and make it unclear which rule is authoritative

anti_patterns.dont: ignore groups that are genuine consolidation candidates
anti_patterns.instead: check the companion TODOs before classifying a group as ignore
anti_patterns.why: the wave-3 consolidation TODOs (sql-platform-adapters, core-and-dataframe) target groups where extraction will reduce real maintenance cost
